scientific_integrity: The classical Dixon–Anderson joint compression distribution covers the marginal law as a consequence. Novelty is asserted only for reconstructing all semiaxes from one observed radius marginal or three of its scalar statistics; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to strictly ordered positive semiaxes, dimension three, Haar-uniform central plane sections; finite-sample statistical accuracy is not established and priority remains provisional.
title: Three-statistic recovery of triaxial ellipsoids from random central-section diameters
